newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Mayr-Melnhof buys U.K. waste paper firm.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Mayr-Melnhof buys U.K. waste paper firm.

text.p: Leading European cartonboard manufacturer Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG (MMK) said on Tuesday it had bought British waste paper company Industrial Waste (Paper) Ltd.

The company said in a statement that its British subsidiary MM Recycling UK Ltd had acquired a 100 percent stake in the company. MMK also sold 30 percent of its British holding to the previous owner of Industrial Waste Ltd.
The acquisition increases the volume of MM Recycling UK Ltd to about 120,000 tonnes per year, the statement said.

The Mayr-Melnhof Waste Paper Division has about 30 waste paper companies in Europe, with a total volume of approximately one million tonnes annually. The company said it planned to continue its expansion strategy.
